spots.label: Taiwan Strait
spots.title: Military signaling around Taiwan
spots.summary: The useful Taiwan Strait signal is not one headline; it is the tempo of drills, patrols, blockade talk, and outside naval responses.

stories.title: Taiwan Strait remains a military signaling zone
stories.summary: Keep watching the gap between routine pressure and anything that changes the operational pattern: larger drills, quarantine language, blockade logistics, or unusual US/Japan responses.

spots.label: South China Sea
spots.title: Maritime pressure in the South China Sea
spots.summary: This layer tracks coast-guard and maritime-militia friction where small collisions or water-cannon incidents can become diplomatic crises.

stories.title: South China Sea pressure centers on coast-guard encounters and shoal access
stories.summary: The highest-signal updates are usually not declarations; they are repeated encounters near Scarborough Shoal, Second Thomas Shoal, or Spratly features.

spots.label: Red Sea / Bab el-Mandeb
spots.title: Shipping risk in the Red Sea corridor
spots.summary: Red Sea risk is about whether attacks, insurance costs, and rerouting remain abnormal enough to keep freight away from Suez.

stories.title: Red Sea shipping remains sensitive to Houthi attack risk
stories.summary: The key-area question is whether carriers treat the route as normal again or keep paying the time and fuel penalty to avoid Bab el-Mandeb.

spots.label: Suez Canal
spots.title: Canal transit and rerouting pressure
spots.summary: Suez is the downstream indicator for Red Sea risk: if ships keep rerouting, canal revenue, delivery times, and freight pricing show the pressure.

stories.title: Suez transit is the practical readout for Red Sea disruption
stories.summary: Watch canal traffic and revenue rather than rhetoric; sustained diversions around the Cape are the clearest signal that the shipping corridor is not back to normal.

spots.label: Kashmir
spots.title: India-Pakistan tension around Kashmir

stories.title: Kashmir remains the India-Pakistan flashpoint to watch for escalation
stories.summary: The signal to watch is not only attacks or arrests, but whether either side shifts troop posture, air restrictions, or diplomatic language after an incident.
